notes.title: DEMO UPDATE D.0.1.6
notes.content: [h3][i]GREETINGS! [/i]ːpraisesunː[/h3][p] So here's a little update fixing some stuff,[/p][h3] [u][i][b]NEW:[/b][/i][/u][/h3][list][*][p]You can reflect bullets to the shooter when parried.[/p][/*][*][p]Added bloom setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fog setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added clouds setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added FPS limit setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller vibration to more actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Now bots can parry.[/p][/*][*][p]Added command to kick all bots ("/help" or "/commands" in chat to see all commands)[/p][/*][*][p]Blood Vignette when damaged.[/p][/*][*][p]Random sun direction on all maps. [/p][/*][/list][h3][u][i][b]FIXES:[/b][/i][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed parry timing being too strict at high FPS and added subtle balancing for low FPS players.[/p][/*][*][p]Scoreboard now sorts players by kills.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Camera Shake on certain actions, added setting to disable it too.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bots rotating on death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed /addbot command not working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player not looking at the right direction on spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spawning offset making players clip into walls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bots not blocking damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players not loading map objects when joining late. [/p][/*][/list][h3][u][i][b]CHANGES:[/b][/i][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Increased parry time from 0.3s to 0.4s[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased revolver bullets velocity from 10 to 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you negate 95% of damage when blocking bullets.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you negate 60% of damage when blocking swords.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified Damage Particle.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased bots amount possible. [/p][/*][/list][h3][u][i][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/i][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Scoreboard names may fuck up when joining late.[/p][/*][*][p]Alt-tabbing may fuck up the game’s window.[/p][/*][/list][h3]  [i]~ Thank you all for your kind words ~[/i][/h3][p][i]Seriously, they motivate me to keep giving 100% of my abilities to this project.[/i][/p][h3][i][b] [/b][/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300632/dd15244b54d63fd8522a812673af481eec6859f8.jpg"][/img][/h3][p] [i]~ Me, myself, and R4v3nB14ck ~[/i][/p]
